series.summary: On middle school graduation day, Rentaro Aijou confesses his love to his classmate Asakawa, only to suffer his 100th consecutive rejection. Utterly devastated, he decides to pray for a miracle at a matchmaking shrine.

segments.voiceover_text: On graduation day, Rentaro Aijou believes his cursed streak of bad luck is finally over.
He pours his heart out to his classmate Asakawa, only to receive the most brutal rejection of his life.
This devastating failure marks his one hundredth consecutive heartbreak since kindergarten, shattering his spirit.
His friends can only watch in disbelief, noting that nobody in history has ever suffered a hundred romantic rejections in a row.
Desperate for a miracle before high school begins, Rentaro visits a sacred matchmaking shrine to pray for love, completely unaware of the divine shock waiting for him.
